title: Prepare for Forever, Try Midnight’s Talebound, and Discover Sweet Treats in WoW Weekly — World of Warcraft
text:
Prepare for Forever, Try Midnight’s Talebound, and Discover Sweet Treats in WoW Weekly — World of Warcraft — Blizzard News 
 Blizzard News 
 World of Warcraft 
 Prepare for Forever, Try Midnight’s Talebound, and Discover Sweet Treats in WoW Weekly 
 Prepare for Forever, Try Midnight’s Talebound, and Discover Sweet Treats in WoW Weekly
 Blizzard Entertainment 
 From the global launch of World of Warcraft: Forever on November 4 to the eerie adventures of Midnight’s Talebound demo and November’s sweet-themed Trading Post, this week’s news is packed with helpful guides, fresh stories, new rewards, and haunting additions to your collection.
 World of Warcraft: Forever Goes Live Globally November 4! 
 Begin your first adventure or return to a new and reimagined Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever, launching worldwide November 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST. Adventure to level 60 across the original continents, discover new stories, and meet fellow adventurers in a permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW, where community comes first, and the journey matters as much as the destination.
 Click to Learn More 
 New Player’s Starter Guide: Welcome to World of Warcraft: Forever 
 World of Warcraft: Forever invites players into a reimagined original Azeroth where exploration, community, and the journey itself take center stage.
 Your first steps in Azeroth begin with a few meaningful choices: how you want to play, who you want your character to become, and where curiosity will lead you. Start at level one, shape a character of your own, and learn the essentials to find your place in a world designed to unfold for years to come.
 Click to Learn More 
 Return to Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever 
 Welcome back to Azeroth. Whether it's been a few years or many, familiar roads, old friends, and new adventures await you in World of Warcraft: Forever.
 To help you get your feet on the ground and begin your adventures in Azeroth once more, we’ve put together some information you may need to return to your hero’s journey.
 Click to Learn More 
 Watch the WoW: Forever Podcast: All About Tech 
 Join WoW: Forever Podcast host Countdown To Classic and special guest Shobek as they talk tech with Senior Game Designer Josh “Aggrend” Greenfield, Lead Software Engineer Ana Resendez, and Principal Software Engineer Frank Williams.
 Watch the episode to get insights from the development team about World of Warcraft: Forever arriving globally on November 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST!
 Your Next Adventure in WoW: Forever Starts in the WoW Portal Room 
 Azeroth has always been more than a place to play—it is a world shaped by the people we meet along the way. The WoW Portal Room offers a starting point for making those connections, whether you’re searching for familiar camaraderie or an entirely new circle of adventurers.
 The WoW Portal Room is ready to welcome World of Warcraft: Forever players and help them build on the friendships, stories, and shared adventures that make Azeroth feel like home.
 Click to Learn More 
 Watch the WoW: Forever Short Story, “Unbowed” 
 Cormack, a former Scarlet Crusader in life, now raised as Forsaken, struggles to accept his undead existence.
 After confronting both his past and the beliefs that defined him, he is left to ask himself: can a Forsaken still serve the Light?
 Join Cormack for a special fireside telling of our newest short story, “Unbowed”.
 Downloadable PDF 
 Big Numbers, Legendary Heroes 
 Behind every number is a hero—and the WoW: Forever beta had plenty.
 Who knew that an unassuming Kobold miner could be so deadly?
 Thank you for participating.
 WoW: Midnight’s Talebound Demo is Now Live 
 Take the Talebound demo for a spooky spin on the Player Test Realm (PTR) and experience the Red Hollow introduction, three eerie tales across Normal, Veteran, and Heroic difficulties, and all three classes: Slayer, Inquisitor, and Witch.
 Dive into the Talebound demo, try the available features, and share your thoughts. No subscription is required to take part.
 Click to Learn More 
 Satisfy Your Sweet Tooth in November’s Trading Post 
 Bring your appetite for adventure—this month is all about indulging your sweet side! November’s Trading Post is serving up a sugar rush with the Sweet Tooth theme, ready to add a little sweetness to your collection. Complete activities to earn Trader’s Tender, and fill your Traveler’s Log to claim this month's bonus reward: the Hot Motocross Bunmover 4600 mount.
 "When dessert manufacturing meets speed optimization. Intact bun delivery not guaranteed." 
 Hot Motocross Bunmover 4600 Mount (Front)
 Hot Motocross Bunmover 4600 Mount (Back)
 Visit T&W (Tawney and Wilder) just outside the Mage District in Stormwind, or the Zen’shiri Trading Post next to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar, to check out the latest items they have available. Players can also visit the Trading Post in the capital cities of Dornogal (The Foregrounds) on the Isle of Dorn and in the renewed Silvermoon City , where representatives of both Tawney and Wilder and the Zen’shiri Trading Post are open for business.
 Champions new to or returning to World of Warcraft and Midnight can tour the Trading Post to learn everything you need to know, from where to find it to how you can earn additional Trader's Tender through the Traveler's Log.
 Add the Living Heartsbane Cauldron Mount to your Collection 
 Rising from the remnants of a dark ritual, this living cauldron bears the marks of the witchcraft that awakened it. Take command of this cursed creation and ride across Azeroth in wicked style.
 The Living Heartsbane Cauldron is a delightfully macabre mount, ready to whisk you into adventures by ground or sky.
 Visit the Shop 
 Bring the Spirit of the Sea Home with the New Grimtide Estate and Grimtide Decor Packs! 
 Risen from the very depths, bring the haunting spirit of the sea home with the Grimtide collection for World of Warcraft Housing, featuring the Spirited Grimtide Manse exterior, Spirited Grimtide Foyer interior, and a coordinated pack of eerie nautical decor.
 The Grimtide Estate and Grimtide Decor packs are sure to bring the horrors from below crashing into your home.
